display.purpose: Active speaker focus on the 1280x720 conference video tile and hero headings.

headline.purpose: Workspace section headers and meeting protocol titles.

title.purpose: Speaker turn headers and canonical glossary terms.

body.purpose: Transcript paragraphs and summaries (65-72ch max measure).

label.purpose: Tabular timestamps and literal in-call chat command keycaps.

shadows.name: dispatch-bar
shadows.purpose: Subtle resting depth on primary quick-dispatch and glossary input bars.

motion.name: ease-dispatch
motion.purpose: 180ms border-color transition on focus-within and status transitions.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-contrast pill button for singular primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #fafaf9; color: #111113; padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10b981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Speaker Filter Chip
components.description: Interactive speaker filter pill with tabular speech-time share.
components.css: .ds-speaker-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #2b2d38; background: transparent; color: #fafaf9; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-speaker-chip:hover { border-color: #a8a29e; } .ds-speaker-chip.active { border-color: #10b981; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.14); } .ds-speaker-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10b981; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pct { color: #a8a29e; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Chat Command Keycap
components.description: Distance-legible monospace keycap used for in-call chat controls.
components.css: .ds-keycap { display: inline-block; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #fafaf9; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; }

components.name: Dispatch Input Bar
components.description: Elevated action strip for meeting URL dispatch and glossary entry.
components.css: .ds-dispatch { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #2b2d38; background: #181920; padding: 14px 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-dispatch:focus-within { border-color: #10b981; } .ds-input { flex: 1; background: #111113; color: #fafaf9; border: 1px solid #2b2d38; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10b981; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Acoustic Horizon Indicator
components.description: Full-width emerald acoustic horizon line with symmetrical voice-reactive center bars.
components.css: .ds-horizon { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 0; background: #111113; } .ds-rule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.36); } .ds-bars { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; } .ds-bars i { display: block; width: 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: #34d399; }

narrative.overview:
Wortlaut.cloud pairs the calm editorial restraint of an archival minutes ledger with live acoustic telemetry. Across both the Astryx Stone web workspace (worker/src/ui/) and the 1280×720 WebRTC conference video tile (worker/runtime/video-tile.ts), neutral Stone grounds carry the structure through 1px hairlines and clear typographic scale rather than nested card boxes or decorative gradients.

Color acts strictly as state proof: emerald (--wl-accent) signals active speech capture and verified brand presence, while warm amber (--wl-warn-text) appears exclusively when a bot waits for host admission or a participant pauses capture Off-the-Record (#pause). Cold navy-slate cards, rainbow speaker side-stripes, and model-name jargon are explicitly rejected.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral Stone surfaces (light / dark / system) built on @astryxdesign/core and @astryxdesign/theme-stone.
Flat editorial sectioning divided by 1px hairlines (var(--color-border)), reserving elevated containers for primary input bars (.wl-dispatch-bar).
Emerald acoustic signal (#059669 light / #10b981 & #34d399 dark) for live voice waveforms, focus rings, and active speaker states.
Distance-legible conference video tile (Ruhiger Sprach-Horizont) engineered for 2×2–3×3 gallery grids.

rules.name: The State-Only Chroma Rule
rules.body: Saturated emerald and amber appear only when proving live capture state, active speech, focus, or Off-the-Record pause—never as decorative card fills or per-speaker rainbow stripes.

rules.name: The Gallery-Distance Rule
rules.body: On the 1280×720 conference video tile, primary status pills and chat command keycaps never drop below 21px (~7px inside a 3×3 grid cell), and headings carry no uppercase eyebrows or kickers.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Card Rule
rules.body: Never place a bordered card inside another bordered card; group subsections with spacing and 1px horizontal rules.

dos: Do use dir="auto" and .wl-break-anywhere on user-authored titles, speaker names, transcript turns, and glossary terms/aliases.
Do guard async form submissions with a synchronous useRef lock alongside loading state, and provide Undo or restore paths for 1-click deletions.
Do keep bottom-left safe-area clearance (x < 520, y > 620) on the 1280×720 conference video tile so provider nameplates never obscure content.
donts: Don't render colored border-left stripes (> 1px), nested card-in-card wrappers, or uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't expose internal model names (Qwen3-ASR) in everyday operator subtitles where plain domain language ("Spracherkennung") suffices.
Don't crowd the 1280×720 conference video tile with multi-paragraph transcript walls that become illegible inside a 3×3 gallery grid.
